task.title: Finish L12-BFF-001 acceptance defects and proof drills

scope.owned_layer: Task-scoped acceptance reconfirmation and reproducible proof evidence for the merged L12-BFF-001 implementation.
scope.not_changing: Merged BFF, telemetry, or incidents product code; hosted deployment; service credentials; runtime manifests; active workers; trading RuntimeBinding semantics; or program-level twelve-loop completion.

proof_drills.proves: The monitor emits pantheon.infrastructure-health/1 without invented trading RuntimeBinding fields.
A service-JWT and tenant/producer-bound monitor event is admitted by the real strict telemetry application route and durable ledger.
Two replicas sharing the durable store post one stable event and a restarted monitor reads the persisted degraded target state.
HTTP 409 is fail-closed into DLQ and governed replay reuses the exact event identity.
The BFF replay route requires approval data under MFA-bound operator auth and persists the replay actor/result.
All configured default and newly discovered owner targets enter the registry, and a 2-of-3 failure window emits one error-rate event.
A real loopback HTTP target stops and recovers while the controller emits three telemetry deliveries, opens one incident, resolves it, and retains the mapping.
A failed incident-open stays durable across restart; recovery remains dependency-blocked until the exact dead letter is replayed, then resolves.
Retention preserves the active incident-open dependency and a restarted controller resolves recovery with zero backlog.

incident_application_route_proof.proves: The actual incidents application routes create the non-trading IncidentCase, dedupe exact replay, reject conflicting reuse, ignore caller-supplied fake runtime binding shape, and resolve through the canonical status route.

acceptance.criterion: Repair telemetry admission authority; repair incident resolution via actual app routes; add durable restart/two-replica dedupe.
acceptance.proof: PD1 through PD3 and the five incidents application-route tests pass on current dev.

acceptance.criterion: Cover the complete configured downstream registry.

acceptance.criterion: Prove retry, DLQ, replay, restart, recovery, and retention behavior.
